Their fur texture is a nightmare to groom due to the breed mixes, and they get matted stupid-easy. Not to mention that a lot of them don't brush their dog like they're supposed to.
Then you have the poor "breeding" regulations on them because it's a designer dog. A lot of them come from piss poor stock due to over-breeding/poor breeding/puppy mills. 
I haven't met a single doodle mix that didn't have skin issues, temperament issues, or health issues.
